ledger: truck | white cab parked outside | green cab parked outside | color change between scenes
man | seated at counter | leaves then reseats | discontinuous presence
cash | not present | fanned bills on counter | sudden appearance

findings.description: The truck parked outside changes from a white cab at the start of the video to a dark green cab at the end.
The man is seen leaving the diner at 01:15 but is seated back at the counter drinking coffee at 01:31 without re-entering.
A fan of cash appears on the counter next to the coffee mug without any visible action of it being placed there.
